name: AlPO4 berlinite
citation: B. P. Onac and H. S. Effenberger. Re-examination of berlinite (AlPO4) from the Cioclovina Cave, Romania. American Mineralogist 92 (2007), 1998-2001.
recommendation: recommended first-round source candidate; FEFF validation pending
method: Experimental single-crystal X-ray diffraction of natural berlinite, confirmed by the authors institutional abstract.
notes: Natural sample from Cioclovina Cave, Romania; not a laboratory synthesis.
The article discusses heating during mineral formation; that formation history is not the diffraction measurement temperature.
Absorber is P at unique crystallographic site index 2; Al site 1 is not the requested absorber.
The source CIF has no atom occupancy column; parser treats sites as fully occupied. This is not an explicit occupancy measurement.
Pressure is not numerically specified in the inspected source; leave measurement_pressure_GPa null.
measurement_conditions_evidence: Raw CIF lacks numeric measurement temperature and pressure; author abstract https://digitalcommons.usf.edu/gly_facpub/102/ does not specify them.

license.database_policy: COD dedicates its data/database to the public domain under CC0; retain original article attribution and original file notice.
license.original_file_notice: CIF header identifies AMCSD as original data provider and requests proper attribution to the journal article.
